title: LDA of PA Presents Early Literacy Tutoring
location_full: CLP – Brookline, 708 Brookline Boulevard, Pittsburgh, PA, 15226, United States
description:
LDA of PA is excited to offer its Early Literacy Instruction program for students in kindergarten through second grade at CLP – Hill District and CLP – Brookline. Pairing up to four students per tutor and utilizing multi-sensory reading tutoring techniques\, this program teaches reading\, spelling\, and handwriting in fun\, interactive\, and multisensory ways. The curriculum includes sight words\, sound mastery\, letter formation\, phonics\, vocabulary\, fluency\, reading comprehension\, the alphabetic principle\, and more. 
Students that need reading support at specific grade levels can join fun and interactive classes:   
At CLP – Brookline we offer tutoring Mondays and Wednesdays 3:15-4 PM ; and Tuesdays and Fridays 3-5 PM.   
At CLP – Hill District we offer tutoring on Mondays and Wednesdays from 3-5 PM. 
Students will be expected to attend 2 sessions per week at their chosen library to make significant progress in their literacy skills. Registration is required. Once a student has registered\, LDA of PA will respond via email or phone to enroll the student in the appropriate class. Register your student here. 
Please note: By clicking on the registration link\, you will be leaving a Carnegie Library of Pittsburgh-managed website. CLP is not responsible for the content or privacy practices of external registration platforms.

title: Community Scan Day
location_full: CLP – Lawrenceville, 279 Fisk Street, Pittsburgh, PA, 15201, United States
description:
Scan your old photographs\, documents\, slides\, and more for free at Community Scan Day! Staff will teach you how to use a portable scanner to digitize your items at CLP locations. If you’d like to donate digital copies to the CLP Digital Community Collection\, a staff member will walk you through the donation process. Carnegie Library of Pittsburgh’s Archivist will be joining the program to showcase materials from CLP-Lawrenceville’s institutional archive! 

Appointments are 40 minutes long\, with a limit of 10 items. You must bring your own storage for your scans\, such as a flash drive or portable hard drive. 
Acceptable items (no larger than 8.5” x 11.7”) include: 

Print photographs
Hand-written and typed documents
Negatives and slides

Book your time slot with this link.
